claim: Imports a recipe and scales every linked ingredient amount in its cooking steps without changing exact fractions.
where: landing page, README, ingredient list, procedure
sandbox: fresh browser; import a recipe with 3/16 tsp, assert 3/16 appears in the list and its bound step, then scale to 8 servings and assert 3/8 in both places

claim: Recipes use a title, servings, ingredients, and steps; quantities may be numbers or fractions.
sandbox: parse the documented YAML recipe and assert its title, ingredients, and bound step

claim: A step can list ingredient ids when its text has no inline ingredient token.
sandbox: parse a JSON step with an ingredients list and assert its binding ids

claim: Saves actual yield corrections locally after cooking
sandbox: 390px browser; complete the sample cook, enter 5.5 servings, cross the 3.2-second ready-toast boundary, and save

claim: Arrow-key cooking remains available when screen wake is unsupported.
sandbox: fresh browser with navigator.wakeLock removed; start the sample cook, assert the disabled wake control explains the fallback, then advance with ArrowRight

claim: Exports the active cook card as JSON.
sandbox: fresh browser; open the sample, download JSON, and parse the downloaded file

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; load the app, save the sample card, set the context offline, and reload

claim: The sample demo does not save to your real cook card
sandbox: open /demo, edit servings, and assert only demo:scc: browser storage keys exist

claim: Recipe data stays in this browser and the cooking flow makes no analytics or third-party runtime requests.
sandbox: record requests while saving a sample correction and assert each request is same-origin

claim: Kitchen Pass checkout is shown only in builds where it is enabled, and a purchased license can be restored locally.
where: landing page, Kitchen Pass dialog, README, terms
sandbox: fresh browser; assert the default build exposes no broken checkout link, intercept the documented verification URL with a valid recorded fixture, submit a fixture token, and observe the active state

claim: Kitchen Pass costs $9 once when checkout is enabled.
where: landing page, Kitchen Pass dialog, README, terms
sandbox: checkout-enabled production preview; assert the visible $9 once price and documented hosted checkout URL

claim: Kitchen Pass keeps unlimited local cook cards and complete local cook history.
where: Kitchen Pass dialog, landing page, README, terms
sandbox: restore a valid fixture license, save two cook cards and two corrections for one card, reload, and assert all records remain

claim: The free cook card keeps one saved cook card and its latest correction.
sandbox: fresh browser; replace the first cook card with a second and save two corrections, then assert only the second card and latest correction remain

claim: Checkout is hosted by Sociobot/Dodo, and a revoked license stops paid features.
sandbox: checkout-enabled preview; assert the documented hosted URL and a recorded revoked verification response locks the paid library

claim: The notebook artwork was generated for this product with Azure AI Foundry.
sandbox: inspect the retained design provenance, source metadata, and referenced public artwork

claim: No payment-provider SDK or product id is embedded here.
sandbox: build the application and inspect source and output for provider SDKs and payment product identifiers

claim: Versioned assets are cached for one year.
sandbox: inspect the Static Web Apps cache rules for hashed and versioned assets
